info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Healthcare Appointments Providers-v3-spec
info.description: This API provides access to a list of healthcare appointment providers, enabling users to easily find and connect with available services. It supports developers building applications that facilitate the scheduling of appointments with healthcare professionals. Typical consumers include patient management systems, healthcare applications, and telemedicine platforms, allowing them to enhance user experience and streamline appointment management. With real-time data retrieval, users can ensure they have the most up-to-date information on providers in their area.

get.description: This endpoint allows clients to fetch a list of available appointment providers, enabling them to schedule appointments based on provider availability.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving a list of providers related to appointments. This includes necessary parameters to filter and specify the type of providers to be fetched.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of providers.
